text:
Type: set of four dark ceramic plant pots
Use: holding small plants, succulents or herbs on a windowsill, shelf or desk; living room, home office, kitchen
Style: minimalist, Japandi, contemporary
Materials: matte ceramic with a fine sandy texture
Colors: dark charcoal grey, matte
Shape: four small pots in different sculptural profiles, a footed cup, a rounded cylinder, a flared top rim and a bulbous top over a narrow base, compact and solid
Feel: calm, earthy, sculptural, modern
Goes with: green plants, light wood, concrete, white or grey walls; Japandi, minimalist or industrial rooms

product.name: SINNERLIG
product.description: Waterproof because it has been treated on the inside.
